s.t:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Core to Figma’s success—and heart—is our community. We care deeply about empowering our community, particularly through a time of rapid change in the industry, and one of the ways we can do that is through education.

We’re looking for a Motion Designer to join our Product Education team. They’ll use their knowledge of Figma, design, and pedagogy to teach our users to successfully adopt Figma into their toolkit..

Day to day, you'll create guided video tutorials for our YouTube Channel, as well as collaborate with other departments on other types of video content. You'll use your skills in motion and design to artfully explain complex topics in terms understandable by junior and prospective designers, empowering them to create.

Our ideal candidate is a passionate educator and collaborator, who is driven by their curiosity to solve problems and learn something new. They're an effective communicator and sweat the details. They should feel comfortable communicating concepts to beginner-level designers and developers in a way that lifts them up and helps them grow.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

· Manage end-to-end video production, from inception to delivery

· Collaborate with Education Designers and Content Strategists to create concise and clear scripts, and record voice overs

· Ideate new videos, record audio and video, create visual assets, animate, edit, write descriptions, and publish final videos to YouTube

· Create eye-catching motion graphics explainers, animations, and transitions to enhance and augment screen recordings

· Work with our Product and Engineering teams to understand how new and existing features work, and the problems they solve for our users

· Collaborate with the Marketing, Brand, Community, and Growth teams to coordinate positioning of our content for new features

· Identify key success metrics, perform lightweight analytics, and engage with our users in video comments

s.h: We'd love to hear from you if you have
s.t:
· Experience animating educational content for SaaS products and features

· Demonstrated ability to create clear, concise, approachable, and accessible content

· Proven ability to identify the optimal way to teach complex concepts or features, with a willingness to abandon ideas that didn't work along the way

· Track record of creative, collaborative brainstorming on new projects and ideas

· Passion for democratizing design and development, making career paths and opportunities accessible to everyone

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Pay Transparency Disclosure

Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location.

Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off.

Figma provides paid sick leave, holidays, and other leave benefits in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the requirements of the Washington Minimum Wage Act and related regulations. Exempt employees are eligible for employer‑provided paid flexible PTO in addition to flexible paid sick leave.

PTO is subject to manager approval. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts. Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles.

All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish.

Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status , or any other characteristic protected by law.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets.

By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly.

Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Design at Brex

Design at Brex creates the experiences that make complex systems feel effortless through thoughtful, scalable design. Whether crafting interfaces, shaping product strategy, or harnessing AI to empower our users, we obsess over quality and clarity. This is a team where creativity meets high craft, and where designers grow by building for ambitious customers.

Brex is looking for a Sr. Motion Designer to join our Design team — a cross-disciplinary group of creatives that’s defining how Brex looks, moves, and communicates across every customer touchpoint. You’ll have the opportunity to shape and lead how Brex is perceived visually — not just through the work you create, but by developing the principles that guide how we use motion as a brand and product expression.

You’ll lead the creation of polished product demos, thoughtful UI animations, and compelling brand campaigns that bring clarity, energy, and emotional resonance to our platform. From launch videos and feature walkthroughs to educational content and social assets, your work will help define a motion language that feels distinctly Brex — and becomes essential viewing for modern finance and product teams.

This is a hands-on, collaborative role where you’ll partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Design to ensure our motion storytelling is strategic, consistent, and high-impact.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require three days per week in office - Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

· Concept, storyboard, and execute polished product demos, launch videos, and promotional campaigns

· Bring the Brex platform to life with thoughtful motion design across product UI, brand systems, and marketing

· Partner with Product Marketing, Web, and Brand teams to ensure our stories are strategic, clear, and beautifully told

· Evolve and maintain a consistent motion language for Brex across channels and formats

· Edit interviews, testimonials, and narrative content with a focus on authenticity and pacing

· Guide best practices around video production, recording, and animation workflows

· Elevate our creative standards by giving and receiving thoughtful feedback

· Contribute to a culture of design excellence, mentorship, and creative exploration

· 7+ years of motion design experience

· A portfolio that demonstrates mastery of visual storytelling, UI motion, and brand animation

· Deep experience with tools like After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Figma, and sound design basics

· Familiarity with front-end animation (Rive, Framer, etc.)

· Strong sense of composition, pacing, and visual hierarchy

· Ability to translate complex product concepts into emotionally resonant video

· Experience owning projects from idea through delivery with a high degree of autonomy

· Clear communicator who thrives in cross-functional collaboration

· Experience directing vendors or freelance motion designers

· Fluency in 3D animation or illustration

· Comfortable editing short-form social content, testimonials, and launch sizzles

· Experience with AI video and visual creation tools

The expected salary range for this role is $147,000- $187,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

At Sierra, we’re creating a platform to help businesses build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices in Atlanta, New York, London, Paris, Madrid, Munich, Singapore, Tokyo, and Sydney.
We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps.

Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.
We’re looking for a Motion Designer to join Sierra’s Creative Studio and help define how our brand comes to life through movement. This role is ideal for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking—someone who can create standout motion work while establishing the patterns, principles, and frameworks that make Sierra recognizable across every touchpoint.
As a member of Sierra’s design team, you’ll partner closely with brand designers, marketers, product teams, and external creative partners to bring stories, products, and experiences to life through animation. You’ll work across product launches, marketing campaigns, customer stories, events, social content, and emerging brand initiatives, helping translate complex AI concepts into compelling visual narratives.
This is an opportunity to help build Sierra’s motion practice from the ground up and shape how customers, partners, and the broader industry experience our brand.

Create high-quality motion design work across marketing campaigns, product launches, customer stories, events, social content, and brand initiatives.
Develop motion systems, principles, and animation frameworks that create consistency and recognition across the Sierra brand.
Build scalable motion templates, guidelines, and documentation that
empower teams to create on-brand work efficiently.
Partner closely with brand design, marketing, product, and leadership teams to elevate storytelling through animation and motion.
Bring creative, from-the-ground-up thinking to brand campaigns and launches, exploring new ways to communicate Sierra’s vision and technology.
Help establish best practices for motion across digital, experiential, social,
and product touchpoints.
Mentor teammates and provide guidance on motion design craft, workflows,
and execution.
Explore new creative possibilities enabled by AI while maintaining a high bar
for quality, taste, and craftsmanship.
As a core member of Sierra’s design team, you will help shape the culture,
systems, and visual language that define our brand.

Proven Experience: 8+ years of motion design experience with a portfolio that demonstrates exceptional craft, strong storytelling, and the ability to build scalable design systems. Experience supporting high-growth technology, SaaS, AI, B2B, or consumer brands is preferred.
Motion Craft Excellence: Deep expertise in animation principles, timing, visual storytelling, typography, and motion systems. Ability to create work that is both visually compelling and strategically effective.
Systems Thinking: Experience building motion design frameworks, reusable assets, and scalable standards that enable consistency across teams and channels.
Great Collaboration: Strong ability to communicate creative ideas and partner effectively with designers, marketers, product teams, engineers, executives, and external collaborators.
Excellent Communication : Ability to clearly articulate design rationale, creative direction, and motion principles to diverse stakeholders.
Builder Mindset: Self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys defining new processes, systems, and creative opportunities from scratch.
Creative Proficiency: Expert knowledge of After Effects, Premiere, Figma, and Adobe Creative Suite. Experience with Cinema 4D, Rive, Lottie, AI-powered creative tools, or emerging motion workflows is a plus.

Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.
Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.
Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.
Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.
Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:
Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

Retirement plan dependent on country of employment
Parental leave

Ob digital oder analog, klassisch oder crazy: Wir vereinen alle Disziplinen und entwickeln seit über 42 Jahren für namhafte Kunden, wie Allianz, Coca-Cola, BMW, Nestlé und Rewe Kampagnen, die begeistern. Verstärke unser rund 100-köpfiges Team am Standort Oberursel als:
Junior Videographer & Motion Designer (m/w/d)

Erfahrung mit Kamera, Licht und Ton sowie ein gutes technisches Verständnis für Drehs

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Stripe Brand Studio is a multi-disciplinary team that accelerates the awareness and trajectory of our brand. We craft the creative vision and strategy for different types of projects and audiences, and amplify them across various mediums, channels, objects to environments, and digital and physical experiences.

The Stripe brand identity team is responsible for defining and evolving Stripe’s visual identity, and bringing the Stripe brand to life in new and impactful ways across surfaces. Our goal is to enable the creation of a coherent, high quality brand experience across the user journey, building recognition and trust in Stripe at every turn.

We collaborate with other design systems teams to translate our brand for Stripe.com and Dashboard, and partner with teams across the company on high impact user-facing projects to create work that feels authentic to Stripe at scale.

Motion Designers at Stripe demonstrate a passion for the craft of movement and a deep understanding of how motion communicates brand character. As a member of the Identity team, you will be responsible for defining and elevating Stripe's motion language across new and existing surfaces.

Motion designers at Stripe demonstrate passion for great design and for expanding, evolving, defining, and documenting flexible motion systems that achieve bar-raising quality and consistency for the brand at scale.

The ideal candidate is technically fluent, crisply articulates motion decisions, and collaborates seamlessly with other designers, engineers, marketers, and agency partners.

· Execute motion design direction across Stripe's brand ecosystem—from concept through final delivery

· Champion and influence how the Stripe brand expresses itself through image and motion and develop guidelines, systems, and processes to ensure quality and consistency at scale

· Contribute to and maintain Stripe's motion design system: principles, timing tokens, animation guidelines, and reusable motion components

· Work collaboratively with non-motion designers, elevating and informing each other’s work

· Coordinate with external motion and production studios or contractors in creative strategy, execution, and delivery

· Share motion knowledge and best practices with teammates

· Stay curious and experimental as an avid maker, obsessed with tinkering and iterating to create beautiful things

· Shape a strategic vision that pushes brand boundaries and builds internal awareness of design’s impact at Stripe
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

· Have 5+ years of relevant motion design experience for technical, brand-driven, or product-led organizations

· Expert command of motion design tools: After Effects, Cinema 4D (or Houdini), AI tools, and the Adobe Creative Cloud suite

· Strong portfolio demonstrating high-craft motion work—including brand identity systems, campaign work, in-product animation, and/or data-driven motion

· Deep understanding of animation principles: timing, easing, staging, anticipation, and how motion communicates meaning and brand character

· Are a systems-thinker and excel at extrapolating and extending shared patterns and behaviors

· Working knowledge of emerging motion and AI tools and how they fit into a professional production workflow

· Strong track record delivering high-quality motion work independently, and in close collaboration with cross-functional partners

· Find a meaningful balance between optimizing for speed, quality, and doing challenging, interesting, frame-perfect work

· Are persuasive and humble in explaining your work, process, and decisions and crave feedback to help you design at your best

· Love working with other designers to help them learn and grow—and have them help you learn and grow

· Have excellent organization and presentation skills, and excel in written and verbal communication

· Highly detail-oriented, with a drive for perfection down to the last frame

· Are passionate about Stripe's mission, are dedicated to a user-first mindset, and have experience working with data and insights

Why Harvey
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. With 2400+ customers in 70+ countries, strong product-market fit, and world-class investor support, we’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished.

We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Harvey is hiring a Staff Motion Designer in San Francisco to define how motion shows up across Harvey’s brand, product storytelling, launch moments, web experiences, customer education, and executive-facing creative work.

The role should sit within Brand and Design, reporting into Shawn Farsai, whose current scope includes Brand Marketing and Creative leadership in San Francisco. This is a new senior IC role intended to raise the motion craft bar while still operating with the low-ego, hands-on generalist posture expected of Harvey’s senior brand hires.

The role should build on existing motion and brand hiring standards, including deep portfolio review, visible process, cross-functional collaboration with PMM and Marketing, and practical assessment of prioritization under ambiguity.

The person in this role will help Harvey turn complex AI product ideas into clear, memorable, and reusable motion systems that can scale across product launches, web surfaces, campaign assets, Academy or education assets, events, and internal/external storytelling.

Own the motion design language for Harvey’s brand across launch videos, product explainers, web and campaign moments, event assets, social cuts, sales enablement, and other high-leverage creative surfaces.
Create motion concepts, storyboards, styleframes, animatics, and final motion assets that make complex AI workflows feel clear, premium, and unmistakably Harvey.
Partner closely with Brand, Product Marketing, Product Design, Creative Operations, and other GTM stakeholders to translate positioning, product context, and user needs into motion narratives that can ship quickly.
Develop reusable motion systems, templates, animation principles, and production workflows so Harvey can scale motion output without reinventing the wheel on every request.
Use judgment to scope work appropriately across polished hero moments, scrappy launch needs, quick-turnaround edits, and longer-term brand-system investments.
Raise the craft bar for motion while remaining willing to do the unglamorous but important production work required in a fast-moving creative team.
What You Have
A strong portfolio of motion work that demonstrates storytelling, art direction, animation craft, visual systems thinking, and the ability to explain the process behind finished work.
Deep fluency in motion design tools and workflows such as After Effects, Figma, Cinema 4D, Lottie, Rive, code-adjacent motion, or comparable production tools.
Experience building motion for brand, product, marketing, launch, or education contexts, ideally in a product-led technology company or high-growth SaaS environment.
A demonstrated ability to simplify complex concepts visually without overloading the viewer, including strong instincts for pacing, sequencing, hierarchy, narration, and accessibility.
Strong cross-functional communication skills, including the ability to clarify a brief, align with PMM or Marketing goals, handle competing feedback, and prioritize multiple stakeholder requests.
A staff-level ownership mindset: able to bring ideas, shape systems, operate through ambiguity, give and receive feedback well, and still roll up sleeves when the team needs execution support.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role sits at the intersection of motion design, visual storytelling, and generative AI. You will create compelling creative content across static, motion, and video formats while helping evolve how content is produced, localized, personalized, and scaled globally.

Your ability to combine exceptional design craft with emerging AI technologies will be instrumental in shaping the future of our creative production.

You will leverage both traditional design tools and AI-powered tools and workflows to develop concepts, generate assets, accelerate production, and create high-quality content across multiple platforms and markets.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to influence our creative capabilities while pushing the boundaries of what is possible through the combination of human creativity and AI.

s.h: In this role you'll get to
s.t:
Creative Development & Storytelling

· Develop creative assets for our B2B and B2B2C marketing channels, including social media, PR, display advertising, sales enablement, and digital experiences.

· Create engaging motion graphics, animations, videos, and visual storytelling content—including short and long-form manifest videos, event videos, explainers and product showcases - across multiple formats, languages, and platforms.

· Participate in the full creative process, from ideation and storyboarding through production and final delivery.

· Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business objectives and project requirements into compelling creative solutions.

· Pitch and present creative concepts, ideas, and executions to managers and key stakeholders.

AI-Driven Creative Innovation

· Leverage AI-powered creative tools to accelerate concept development, storyboarding, image and video generation, editing, adaptation, and production workflows.

· Explore emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to improve creative quality, efficiency, personalization, and scale.

· Help evolve how content is produced and scaled through the combination of human creativity and AI.

Creative Excellence & Operations

· Deliver top-quality work in a fast-paced environment, ensuring high standard of craft and brand consistency.

· Stay current with design trends, platform developments, AI advancements, and emerging creative technologies.

Creative & Motion Design Expertise

· 5+ years of experience in Motion Design, Graphic Design, Content Creation, Advertising, or a related creative discipline.

· Outstanding portfolio demonstrating excellence in motion design, visual storytelling, content creation, campaign development, and commercially deployed AI-assisted creative work.

· Strong understanding of design fundamentals, typography, composition, motion principles, editing, pacing, and visual storytelling.

· Proven ability to translate creative briefs and business objectives into compelling visual solutions.

Creative Technology & AI

· Advanced proficiency in industry-standard creative tools including After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, and related software.

· Demonstrated experience creating AI-generated imagery and video for commercial marketing applications using platforms such as Runway, Veo, Imagen, Seedance, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, GPT Image, or similar tools.

We are looking for an experienced, highly motivated and passionate Senior Animator who will create stunning visuals and shape the narrative of our games through their animations. She/He possesses a strong balance of creative and technical skills, with a generalist profile capable of moving fluidly between 2D and 3D animation, and additional expertise in animation pipeline development and rigging collaboration with other teams.

Our team of Animators are responsible for bringing characters, objects and environments to life in gameplay and cinematics for several projects in the company, where they find opportunities to move among diverse animation styles and animation challenges — from stylized to realistic, from 3D character work to 2D skeletal animation in Spine. The primary responsibility is to create immersive game experiences to achieve the best player experience possible, aligned with the game's overall vision.

This role is unique in scope: the Senior Animator will work both on established productions with mature pipelines and on new projects and prototypes, where they will partner closely with engineering to help define how the animation pipeline should be structured from the ground up. They collaborate effectively with art, design, audio and engineering teams to identify and implement the animation needs of each project, establish efficient riggings, and continuously improve our animation processes.

· Craft: You have a strong foundation in traditional animation principles and apply them fluently across both 3D and 2D (Spine, Unity's native animation tools). You're a generalist at heart — comfortable jumping between styles, dimensions, and tools — with a solid technical mind that understands the importance of a well-established animation pipeline and an optimal rigging setup.

· Pipeline Builder: You're equally comfortable executing within a structured pipeline and helping shape one from scratch. On new projects and prototypes, you partner with engineering to define how the animation pipeline should work — from rigging conventions to runtime integration.

· AI-Forward: You stay deeply up to date with the latest AI advances and are constantly exploring how AI can accelerate asset production and improve animation processes, workflows and pipelines. You see AI as a creative and technical multiplier and actively bring those opportunities into the team.

· Documentation: You are good at structuring and organizing content, documenting everything and making it accessible for everyone. You are a great communicator of changes, tools and processes.

· Team Player: You are a self-motivated team player who proactively seeks feedback and shares knowledge. You're good at interacting with a wide range of people from very distinct backgrounds and specialties.

· Pipeline Awareness: You stay on top of the latest tools and techniques to help shape our animation pipelines.

As a Motion Designer, you will craft high-quality animations, micro-interactions, and motion graphics that bring our digital experiences to life. Your work will improve usability, reinforce our brand identity, and create seamless interactions across web and mobile platforms. Through motion and storytelling, you will transform complex financial concepts into intuitive, engaging experiences that build trust and connection with users.

Collaborating with product designers, engineers, and marketers, you will define motion principles, contribute to our design system, and prototype animations that drive product innovation. Your role will be instrumental in making financial interactions feel smooth, emotionally engaging, and deeply human.

· Design and prototype motion interactions for web and mobile, creating seamless, engaging, and intuitive experiences.

· Collaborate with product designers, developers, illustrators, and marketing teams to integrate motion across product features, onboarding flows, and brand campaigns.

· Define and maintain motion principles and guidelines within the design system for consistency and scalability.

· Create high-fidelity animations using After Effects, Principle, Figma, or Framer, ensuring polished execution.

· Partner with engineers to ensure smooth handoff, technical feasibility, and optimal implementation.

· Iterate on animations based on user feedback, usability testing, and performance insights to refine the experience.

· Stay ahead of motion trends, interaction patterns, and fintech best practices to drive innovation.

What you need to succeed

· Strong experience in interactive motion work, micro-interactions, and UI animations.

· Proficiency in tools such as After Effects, Figma, Framer, Principle, Lottie, Rive, and CSS animations.

· Solid understanding of timing, easing, and physics in animation to create smooth, natural interactions.

· Ability to work within a design system and contribute to scalable motion guidelines.

· Experience collaborating with product designers, engineers, illustrators, and marketing teams in a fast-paced environment.

· Familiarity with prototyping tools and methods to communicate motion intent effectively.

· Knowledge of accessibility considerations in motion design, ensuring inclusive experiences.

· Ability to balance aesthetics with performance and usability considerations

What you’ll get

· The opportunity to work on cutting-edge fintech products that impact millions of users.

· A collaborative and design-driven culture that values creativity and innovation.

· Exposure to a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a talented cross-functional team.

· Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources.

· Competitive compensation and benefits package

What to expect in the hiring process

· Application & portfolio review: We assess your experience, creativity, and ability to produce high-quality motion work.

· Preliminary phone call with the recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, interests, and expectations.

· Design Interview: a deep dive into motion process, toolkits, decision-making, and collaboration approach.

· Motion Design Challenge: a brief, open-ended scenario to assess motion craft, systems thinking, and communication.

· Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership to assess your systems alignment, vision, and culture fit

Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best motion design work. We want to see projects that highlight animation craft, storytelling ability, and impact on user experience. Include examples of micro-interactions, product animations, and marketing motion graphics, with insights into your creative process and decision-making. If you have experience in fintech or SaaS, show how your motion work contributed to user engagement and product success
